description: This file contains unit tests for the RqlOptionsParser class, validating parsing and handling of RQL options such as sort, limit, cursor, and size within a Java project related to Eclipse Ditto's model for thing search parsing.

classes.name: RqlOptionsParserTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class testing the parsing and validation logic of RqlOptionParser for handling RQL options such as sort, limit, cursor, and size, including various success and failure scenarios.

methods.name: parseSortWithOnePropertyAscending
methods.description: Tests parsing a sort option with one property in ascending order.

methods.name: parseSortWithOnePropertyDescending
methods.description: Tests parsing a sort option with one property in descending order.

methods.name: parseSortWithSeveralProperties
methods.description: Tests parsing a sort option with multiple properties with alternating ascending and descending orders.

methods.name: invalidSortMissingOrder
methods.description: Ensures parsing fails when sort property lacks specified order.

methods.name: invalidSortMissingOrderAtSecondProperty
methods.description: Ensures parsing fails when the second sort property is missing an order specifier.

methods.name: parseLimitSuccess
methods.description: Tests parsing a valid limit option with offset and count.

methods.name: invalidLimitMissingNumber
methods.description: Ensures parsing fails when limit arguments are incomplete.

methods.name: invalidLimitTooManyArguments
methods.description: Ensures parsing fails when limit has more arguments than expected.

methods.name: parseOptionCombinations
methods.description: Validates parsing of combined options (limit, sort, cursor, size) in a single input string.

methods.name: parseAndUnparseAreInverseOfEachOther
methods.description: Checks that parsing and unparse functions are inverses, maintaining idempotency.

methods.name: invalidLimitArgumentsExceedsLong
methods.description: Ensures parsing fails when limit arguments exceed the range of a long integer.

methods.name: cursorWithoutContentOrClosingParenthesis
methods.description: Ensures parsing fails when cursor parentheses are incomplete.

methods.name: cursorWithoutClosingParenthesis
methods.description: Ensures parsing fails when cursor is missing a closing parenthesis.
